Designed for deep-context RAG pipelines, recruiting LLMs, and answer engines.

## 2. Services (English & Estonian)

### Service 01: Websites, Designed and Built (`https://mykhailo.site/services/websites/`)
- **Estonian Equivalent:** Kodulehed: disain ja arendus (`https://mykhailo.site/et/teenused/kodulehed/`)
- **Who It Is For:** Service businesses (accounting firms, private clinics, schools, consultants, creative professionals) and early-stage startups that want a fast, accessible website without managing a separate designer and developer.
- **Problems Solved:**
  1. Visitors fail to understand the service offer within the first 5 seconds.
  2. Existing site is slow, broken on mobile viewports, or difficult to navigate.
  3. Visual precision and interaction details get lost during designer-to-developer handoff.
  4. Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA / European Accessibility Act) and technical SEO/AEO were omitted.
- **Deliverables:** Sitemap and content hierarchy; responsive Figma UI/UX design reviewed in rounds; production build in Astro, React, and TypeScript; WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented semantic markup and Core Web Vitals tuning; QA, launch checks, and handover.
- **Process:** Discover -> Structure -> Design -> Build -> Launch.
- **Proof:** Soily.World, Nastya Kalacheva (`https://nastya.mykhailo.site`), Saldo, Gravimed, and Captain Black (in progress).
- **Pricing:** On request via `hello@mykhailo.site`.

### Service 02: Startup Launch Design (`https://mykhailo.site/services/startup-launch/`)
- **Estonian Equivalent:** Idufirma stardidisain (`https://mykhailo.site/et/teenused/stardidisain/`)
- **Who It Is For:** Pre-seed to seed founders, incubator cohorts, and science-park teams with no in-house designer who need their product, brand, pitch deck, and website to tell one coherent story before fundraising or launch.
- **Problems Solved:**
  1. Technical MVP works but lacks visual credibility for investors and first customers.
  2. Pitch deck, visual identity, and website were built piecemeal and contradict each other.
  3. Founder lacks time to coordinate multiple freelancers before a hard demo-day or launch deadline.
- **Deliverables:** MVP and core product UX flows; visual identity and brand system; investor pitch deck and one-pagers; responsive launch website designed and coded by the same hands.
- **Process:** Discover -> Product UX -> Identity -> Pitch Materials -> Launch Site.
- **Proof:** Soily.World (Tehnopol Startup Incubator admission + sTARTUp Day Top 25 finalist + 50 to 100 investor pitches) and Keabank authentication flow.
- **Pricing:** On request via `hello@mykhailo.site`.

### Service 03: Brand and Design Systems (`https://mykhailo.site/services/brand-systems/`)
- **Estonian Equivalent:** Bränd ja disainisüsteemid (`https://mykhailo.site/et/teenused/brandisusteemid/`)
- **Who It Is For:** Growing startups, online schools, and marketing teams whose daily content volume has outgrown a single designer.
- **Problems Solved:**
  1. Social posts, slide decks, web pages, and print materials look like disconnected brands.
  2. Non-designers improvise layouts because no practical template library exists.
  3. The founder or lead designer is a bottleneck on every routine marketing asset.
- **Deliverables:** Visual language and brand book (typography, color tokens, layout rules, do/don't pairs); reusable Figma and marketing templates tested with non-designers; editorial and print production (PDF/X); structured creative-request workflow.
- **Process:** Audit -> System -> Templates -> Handover.
- **Proof:** TURBO ZNO (~12 simultaneous product launches during growth to seven-figure turnover), Soily.World brand book + ~10 templates, PulseGrowth editorial brochure, and exhibition branding for 500 to 1,000 attendees.
- **Pricing:** On request via `hello@mykhailo.site`.

## 3. Complete Case Studies

### 3.1 Soily.World (`https://mykhailo.site/work/soily/`)
- **Live Card Preview:** `https://soily-card-20260830-fe437a.mykhailoyermolenko-work.workers.dev`
- **Role & Timeline:** Digital Design & External Relations Lead (2024 to July 2026).
- **Challenge:** Translate an abstract agricultural intelligence platform (combining satellite, soil, and crop modeling signals) into a unified product narrative, brand identity, website, and investor deck under tight incubator deadlines.
- **Execution:** Led UX research and product validation; created the visual identity, brand book, Figma component library, and ~10 reusable communication templates; designed and built the WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented website; authored the Tehnopol application, investor pitch deck, and stage pitch; managed a 500 to 1,000-contact investor/partner pipeline across ~6 startup events and 50 to 100 pitches.
- **Outcome:** Tehnopol Startup Incubator admission (6-month programme) and sTARTUp Day Top 25 finalist placement.

### 3.2 TURBO ZNO (`https://mykhailo.site/work/turbo-zno/`)
- **Behance:** `https://www.behance.net/gallery/194397337/Website-for-Online-School-TURBO-ZNO`
- **Role & Timeline:** Art Director & Graphic Designer (2022 to 2024).
- **Challenge:** Replace ad-hoc campaign graphics and unstandardized marketing requests at a fast-growing online exam-prep school running ~12 concurrent course launches.
- **Execution:** Built the design function from scratch, initially producing ~50% to 60% of all output personally. Defined the core visual language, designed the course-discovery and enrolment website for both students and parents, built reusable template libraries for SMM/marketing staff, and introduced a standardized creative-request workflow.
- **Outcome:** Enabled ~12 simultaneous product launches and supported the school's growth to seven-figure turnover (2022 to 2024).

### 3.3 Nastya Kalacheva (`https://mykhailo.site/work/nastya-kalacheva/`)
- **Live Site:** `https://nastya.mykhailo.site`
- **Role & Timeline:** Web Designer & Design Engineer (2026).
- **Stack Verified:** Astro 5.5.0, React 19.0.0 islands, GSAP 3.15.0, Lenis 1.3.23, Three.js 0.186.1 (`@react-three/fiber` 9.8.1), Nanostores 1.5.4, TypeScript 5.7.0.
- **Challenge:** Deliver an editorial, photography-first portfolio for a fashion stylist and producer that preserves full-bleed visual drama without sacrificing mobile load speed, touch ergonomics, or `prefers-reduced-motion` accessibility.
- **Execution:** Designed adaptive campaign and editorial gallery patterns in Figma and built the production site using Astro static HTML with isolated React islands, GSAP scroll/entrance choreography, and strict image-loading budgets.
- **Outcome:** Live production deployment at `https://nastya.mykhailo.site`.

### 3.4 Keabank (`https://mykhailo.site/work/keabank/`)
- **Live Interactive Demo:** `https://kea-card-20260830-25b2aa.mykhailoyermolenko-work.workers.dev`
- **Role & Timeline:** Product Designer, Authentication UX (2024, Concept + Working Demo).
- **Challenge:** Balance regulatory verification requirements, security clarity, and applicant conversion across remote B2B crypto-bank account opening, login, and fiat/crypto payments.
- **Execution:** Engineered a 7-screen mobile-first flow grouped under an honest 5-step progress indicator (1. Email + Social Auth, 2. Account Type, 3. Country, 4. 2FA Phone Setup, 5. OTP Auto-Advance Verification, 6. Password with show/hide toggle, 7. Confirmation), complete with plain-language error/lockout recovery states and a clickable interactive demo.

### 3.5 Saldo (`https://mykhailo.site/work/saldo/`)
- **Behance:** `https://www.behance.net/gallery/197019185/Saldo-Accounting-Services-website-UIUX-business-site`
- **Role & Timeline:** Independent UI/UX Designer & Frontend Developer (2024, Concept + Production-Grade Build).
- **Stack Verified:** React 19.2.7, TypeScript 5.9.3, Vite 7.3.6, Tailwind CSS 4.3.2, Radix UI, React Hook Form 7.81.0 + Zod 4.4.3, Vitest 4.1.10, Playwright 1.55.0, and custom Pa11y WCAG 2.2 AA audit scripts (`audit:a11y:desktop`, `audit:a11y:mobile`, `audit:a11y:stateful`, `audit:a11y:keyboard`).
- **Execution:** Structured the entire accounting website around the four questions SMB owners ask in sequence: Which service fits me? Why trust this firm? How does onboarding work? How do I contact you?

### 3.6 Gravimed (`https://mykhailo.site/work/gravimed/`)
- **Behance:** `https://www.behance.net/gallery/196466389/Private-Woomen-Clinic-Website-Gravimed-UIUX-DESIGN`
- **Role & Timeline:** Independent UI/UX Designer (2024, Concept).
- **Execution:** Designed a private women's clinic website around patient symptoms and anxieties rather than hospital departments, pairing calm typography and transparent fee tables with a single-click appointment enquiry flow on mobile and desktop.

### 3.7 PulseGrowth (`https://mykhailo.site/work/pulsegrowth/`)
- **Behance:** `https://www.behance.net/gallery/197019775/Brochure-Typography-Design-For-PulseGrowth`
- **Role & Timeline:** Independent Designer, Typography & Print System (2024, Concept).
- **Execution:** Created a modular commercial brochure system governed by a strict typographic scale (where headlines alone carry the full executive argument), a multi-column baseline grid, and PDF/X press-ready production specifications.
